analysis: Adapt the planner/executor separation; add explicit preconditions and verifier evidence because looping over task state does not itself detect deadlocks.

analysis: Retain the separation between proposals and authorized changes; bind approval to an immutable candidate and current policy version.

output_quote: Each patch is validated against the SQLite task state
analysis: Adapt with actual file hashes and permission checks at execution; database state alone may be stale relative to the filesystem.

output_quote: unified, immutable world representation stored in SQLite
analysis: Adapt as append-only observations plus a mutable projection; observed state is incomplete and cannot make arbitrary external actions reversible.

output_quote: any deviations trigger immediate halting
analysis: Specify fail-closed behavior for concrete invariant violations; anomaly detection is not a proof of permission enforcement.

output_quote: falsifiable, deterministic tests
analysis: Retain deterministic fault injection for recovery, but add exact crash boundaries and measurable invariants; no evaluation results were actually collected by this model.

output_quote: On crash, the runtime automatically snapshots
analysis: Reject as a hard-crash guarantee: the process may execute no cleanup at all. Persist intent before the effect and reconcile after restart.

output_quote: managing a queue of agents
analysis: Adapt into one bounded worker queue initially; no lock, lease or conflict protocol is specified for parallel execution.

output_quote: highly feasible within the local-first constraints
analysis: Unsupported overall feasibility: the proposed VRAM/SQLite coupling is invalid and the 8 GB allocation ignores model and KV-cache requirements.

output_quote: all cognitive actions are traceable and reversible
analysis: Reject universal reversibility. Traceability can be an engineering invariant for logged actions; reversibility depends on the tool and external system.

output_quote: SQLite for persistent storage of task states and event logs
analysis: Retain as a modest starting point already supplied by the prompt; define transactions and distinguish journal durability from external file durability.

output_quote: heuristic-based approach to select the next action
analysis: Useful simpler baseline; add a bounded action budget and deterministic validation. There is no specified heuristic or demonstrated reasoning capability.

output_quote: rewards for correct actions and penalties for incorrect ones
analysis: Defer online RL until reward integrity, offline evaluation and permission invariance are specified; correctness cannot be taken from model self-report.

output_quote: simple command-line interface for tool actions

output_quote: the self as a set of capabilities

output_quote: a simple crash recovery mechanism

output_quote: agents can communicate and coordinate their actions
analysis: Defer: no communication schema, ownership or resource budget. A single executor is the lower-complexity baseline.

output_quote: reward signals from task completion and error rates

analysis: Retain final-state consistency as an observable; replace vague more efficiently and accurately with exact hashes and fault-injection pass criteria.
